args.sql:
with source_data as (
    select
        o_orderkey,
        o_custkey,
        o_orderstatus,
        o_totalprice,
        o_orderdate,
        o_orderpriority,
        _loaded_at,
        row_number() over (partition by o_orderkey order by _loaded_at desc) as _rn
    from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
)
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from source_data
where _rn = 1;

This removes the 3,000 exact duplicate rows while preserving the original column names and types, satisfying the unique constraint on order_key.
